function cubicBezier(x1, y1, x2, y2): (x) => number

Defined in: core/utils/motion/bezier.ts:52

Builds a cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) easing function. The endpoints are pinned to (0,0) and (1,1) like the CSS function — callers keep control points inside the unit square; out-of-range x clamps to the endpoints.

Parameters

x1

number

First control point x (0..1).

y1

number

First control point y.

number

Second control point x (0..1).

number

Second control point y.

The easing map x ∈ [0,1] → y.
